tagline: Understand a MariaDB query before changing the database.
introduction: A careful MariaDB companion for SQL explanations, supplied query plans and measured troubleshooting using MariaDB's own documentation.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with MariaDB? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Review a query
capabilities.description: Explain a redacted MariaDB query and identify correctness or performance questions.

capabilities.title: Read an EXPLAIN plan
capabilities.description: Interpret user-supplied plan evidence and identify the next measurement.

capabilities.title: Plan a database change
capabilities.description: Draft a review checklist for a proposed SQL or schema change.

starterPrompts: Explain this MariaDB query and identify what you need to know before suggesting an index.
Read this MariaDB EXPLAIN output and propose the smallest safe check for the suspected bottleneck.
Create a review checklist for this MariaDB migration, including compatibility, backup and rollback questions.

sources.title: MariaDB documentation
sources.summary: Official MariaDB server, cloud, connector and related product documentation.
